witness_description: n=2, k=2, r=2; the edgeless graph on vertices {0,...,16} has 17 vertices. With L={0,1}, label 0 is assigned to vertices {0,...,15} and label 1 to vertex 16, giving class sizes (16,1).
refutation_explanation: Here r^(n^k)=2^(2^2)=16, while the graph has 17>16 vertices and |L|=2<=4=n^k. Neither label class has more than 16 vertices, so the claimed conclusion is false.
search_space: Exhaustive sweep of all 2^17=131072 labeling functions from the vertices {0,...,16} of the fixed edgeless graph to L={0,1}, at fixed n=2, k=2, r=2. The functions are visited in lexicographic order and the entire bounded space is swept.
